verdict.rationale: Stagehand is itself a developer SDK, documented as available across TypeScript, Python, and Go. It has a quickstart, API reference pages, a named Python SDK wrapped by integrations, and AI-rules snippets to help coding assistants write correct v4 code. Community users report building scrapers with it hands-on. Missing for 10: documented per-language reference depth showing the Python and Go SDKs are at parity with TypeScript.
